releaseTitle: MusicDeck v3.0.0 - Native C++ Audio Engine
releaseNotes: Major audio architecture upgrade: in-house 32-bit floating point C++ DSP engine (libmusicdeck_audio.so), envelope-follower studio peak limiter with zero digital clipping or buzzing harmonics, resonant 80Hz sub-bass shelf, and precision Direct Form II Transposed biquad EQ.
